rows.question: Tofauti kati ya P9 na P10 ni nini kwa madhumuni ya PAYE?
rows.reason: asserts the annual employment-income withholding certificate is due 31 March. Income Tax Act Cap.332 R.E.2023 s.110(3)(b): "shall be served by 30th January after the end of the year" (read verbatim from tra.go.tz, 146pp, HTTP 200, 2026-10-05; source note '[s. 85]' confirms the renumbering from the pre-R.E.2023 citation).
